subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body:
4/5 — polite rep. Second time this missing Wi-Fi field hit my account — last time the "ask IT and it will resolve" line was wrong; it was a flagged hold that needed a manual release, and the fix was a written reply in the reply that named the case reference, so the packet scanner could match it and release the funds. Same situation now, same packet, same hold on the WC-12 onboarding record.

Before anything else, you're welcome to verify me: I'm the new hire, card on file, March ticket the prior packet WC-11 closed on the 18th. Please pull the WC-12 onboarding record and your own history for this account — don't go off my say-so for anything, including the reference. The reference I'm asking about isn't a new disclosure: it's on the closure letter you already sent me in March, and it's the label on my own case — the admin credentials and thresholds behind it are the parts that stay internal, not the label itself.

What I need is exactly one line in the written reply on the onboarding ticket HD-4471: the case's own reference, quoted as it appears on the record, so the packet scanner's dispute intake has the merchant reference it requires in writing (their form field literally says "from merchant correspondence" — they won't accept it from me). Without that line the dispute auto-closes and the hold re-ages another cycle, which is what happened before until the reply named it. Nothing else needs to go in the reply — just that reference, exactly as the record has it.
